Topic.label: Folding and Moving Point Problems in Quadrilaterals

Question:
Fold a rectangular sheet of paper \(ABCD\) along \(AE\) (\(E\) lies on side \(BC\)), so that point \(B\) lands at point \(F\). If \(\angle BAE=25^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle BEF\) in degrees.

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_192_q2_question_en.svg)
Solution: In right triangle \(ABE\), \(\angle AEB=65^\circ\). After folding, \(\angle AEF=\angle AEB=65^\circ\), so \(\angle BEF=130^\circ\).
